title: Vanilla+
subtitle: A quiet Vanilla+ starter with guided Index, PlayerCore homes, HoloMap markers, TutorialCore hints, and a gentle MissionCore checklist.
description: A lightweight ECHO-enhanced vanilla starter that now includes a guided first-session loop for homes, Index pages, map markers, and gentle optional missions without changing the core feel.
first10MinutesPreview: Open Index and read the Vanilla+ welcome page.
Set a home or safe return point with PlayerCore.
Create one HoloMap marker for base, farm, mine, or village.
first30MinutesPreview: Finish a small shelter or base corner.
Mark a farm, mine, or village on the starter HoloMap layer.
Review the TutorialCore card if a module is unfamiliar.
first2HoursPreview: Expand the first base and document recurring routes in Index.
Use PlayerCore homes and HoloMap markers to connect farms, mines, and villages.
Add creator-specific checklist objectives if this becomes a light SMP pack.
